incident.problem: The release artifact and management-crawl verdict retained Pinned BFF transport failed. but discarded pinnedTransport.errors, obscuring which request failed.

contract_verification.method: Read-only GitHub contents API at execute-plans commit 619891d5e; no frontend edits, VM access, SSH or operator keys.
contract_verification.manifest_source: scripts/accept-management-hosted-production.mjs:1103 exports pinnedTransport with pass, errors and terminatedBeforeSend beside result.
contract_verification.error_source: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs:48-51 records label: message strings and replaces the bearer token with [REDACTED].
contract_verification.terminated_source: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs:279-283 records outcome, interceptionId, networkId, path, requestStage, pausePhase, phase and reason. Line 294 uses target_closed_before_continuation.
contract_verification.limits_tested: The supplied real error shape is extended with request query/fragment, environment-secret messages and repeated long messages to test privacy and bounds; these extensions are test inputs, not claimed hosted observations.

solution.artifact: Optional pinnedTransport object: errors (up to 20 strings, each at most 200 characters) and terminatedBeforeSendCount (number of upstream entries). No terminated-before-send row contents are copied.
solution.privacy: Strip query and fragment from the request pathname before clipping. Apply the existing redact() to each new error before clipping, avoiding a partial secret at the boundary, then retain the existing whole-summary redact() path and enforce the final 200-character cap.
solution.verdict: Append the first three retained transport errors to failed management-crawl detail. The existing 2000-character detail cap remains in force.
solution.compatibility: No pinnedTransport key means no additional summary or artifact fields and exactly the previous verdict shape and detail. The schema versions stay unchanged because the fields are optional.
solution.outcomes: No change to result.pass, process exit interpretation, required/skipped behavior, verdict_status, dev gates or rollback policy. Passed and failed manifests retain their respective outcomes even when transport diagnostics are present.

verification.result: 41 passed in 6.22s; exit 0 (34 existing cases and 7 added cases)
coverage: Real pinned transport error reaches the artifact and failed release verdict; both passed and failed result.pass values retain their outcomes.
Two actual-shape terminatedBeforeSend rows become count 2 with no copied interception identifiers; an empty array yields count 0.
25 errors reduce to 20; every retained entry is at most 200 characters, including after short-secret redaction expands the text.
Request query keys, values and fragment are absent; minted token and viewer client secret are redacted; upstream [REDACTED] is preserved.
Only the first three transport errors enter the verdict detail.
A bearer token crossing the character cap is redacted before truncation, so no raw token prefix survives.
Passed and failed manifests without pinnedTransport yield exact pre-change artifact and check fields and detail.
verification.existing_tests: No existing test or assertion was modified, weakened or deleted; new tests are appended.

runtime_budget.cadence: Once per existing post-switch release acceptance crawl; no new recurring job or workflow input.
runtime_budget.hosted_scale_count: At most one optional diagnostics object in the existing acceptance-crawl.json per release attempt; at most 20 retained errors and one integer count.
runtime_budget.size_cap: At most 4000 error characters (20 x 200), plus bounded JSON structure and the decimal count. JSON escaping adds encoding overhead; 4000 characters is not a 4000-byte claim. The verdict includes at most three error strings within its existing 2000-character detail bound.
runtime_budget.growth_per_day: For R release attempts/day, at most 20R retained entries / 4000R error characters plus JSON overhead in the existing release artifacts. No time-based accumulation or new persistence path is introduced.
runtime_budget.cleanup: Existing acceptance verdict/crawl GitHub artifact retention is 30 days (.github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml:4575-4585); runner crawl workspace already uses TemporaryDirectory. No retention or cleanup mechanism is added or changed.
runtime_budget.storage_manifest: No new writer to register; only bounded additional fields in the existing release artifact. This committed evidence file is a static task record, not a runtime output.

hosted_proof.reason: Task explicitly prohibits VM/SSH access and reserves hosted verification for the later operator acceptance task. Local functional evidence does not establish deployed or accepted state.
hosted_proof.follow_up: After deployment, the operator acceptance task inspects acceptance-crawl.json pinnedTransport.errors/terminatedBeforeSendCount and failed check:management-crawl detail at the exact served FE/BFF identities.

scope_boundary: Underlying persona-fleet/inbox/rankings availability and frontend transport behavior remain in their existing owning chains. The coordinator records this task result in the RC1 WP1.2 register row; this task does not edit the register.
